I posted the list to your DM with the sources. Eight sites in total: two from #central-team you can see directly, six from the brain.

The brain search is keyword-only and was partly degraded, and 118 pages haven't been scanned for entity names, so the list may be incomplete. I left out the Marrow Fieldworks sites (Salina Parts Depot, Kearney Machinery Annex, Salina tractor depot) because they belong to the parent account. The two Kearney-area cross-docks come from the 2025 MSA signing notes and name Darla, who is on the Fieldworks side, so please confirm those are Agrisupply sites before you rely on them.
